note: P4378 (Pro 30:25) — the ants are a people not strong, yet they provide their food in the summer.

dims.v: foresight — the ants storing food in summer against winter

the ants' providing of their food in the summer — the provident foresight that, though the ants are weak, lays up in the time of plenty against the time of need, diligence and forethought outweighing strength
(the weakness it more than makes up for)
the forethought that provisions the future in the season of plenty

kun (prepare/provide) — 'the ants are a people not strong, yet they PROVIDE their food in the summer' (cf 6:6-8); foresight and diligence, not strength, secure the future. The weak ant's provident planning is wisdom to be imitated. Emergent: provident forethought as the wisdom of the small.
